audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers award Levels 2 through First item to Volibear, but whys[1], whys[2] and whys[4] all describe Maokai bullying him at exactly those stages, and the packet chart reads Volibear, Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Maokai, Volibear, Volibear.
audit.why: Volibear's only lockdown, Thundering Smash, is 12s at rank 1 and requires him to walk into auto range; Maokai's W is 14s and point-and-click with Sap Magic behind it. Level 1 is genuinely his (Frenzied Maul on a 5s cooldown already heals), and he reclaims from first item onward.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Volibear, Levels 2-3 Maokai, Levels 4-5 Skill, Level 6 Maokai, First item and 2+ items Volibear — matching the packet chart and the existing prose.

audit.why: Spikes are right in shape: Maokai at 2-3 and 6; Volibear at his first item with Sheen and again at 2+ items. Stormbringer is 160/135/110s, so his ult is a once-a-lane-phase event, not a repeatable threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls Sky Splitter (E) his stun — 'his E hand-of-the-god stun', 'who lands their lockdown (my W or his E)'. Volibear's stun is Thundering Smash (Q); Sky Splitter slows and shields him if he stands in the blast.
audit.why: Riot's text: Thundering Smash gives him speed toward enemies and stuns the first target he attacks; Sky Splitter deals damage, slows, and shields him when he is inside the radius. Building your whole lockdown plan around the wrong ability makes the advice actively wrong — you would dodge the slow and eat the stun.
audit.corrected: whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and spikes[2].text now name Thundering Smash as the stun and Sky Splitter as the shield/slow, with the 12s rank-1 stun cooldown in dontsFull[0].d.
sources: brief enemyKit Q text + hardCC flag
brief enemyKit E text + shield/slow flags

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole content layer is written in the first person ('I only have one ability', 'my Sap Magic'), which is not the site's second-person voice.
audit.why: Every other matchup addresses the reader as 'you'.
audit.corrected: Converted in the strings that were already being rewritten for the Sky Splitter error; the remaining first-person prose in early/mid/late is flagged for a voice pass rather than churned here.

audit.why: Thundering Smash 12s at rank 1, Frenzied Maul 5s flat, Stormbringer 160s at rank 1 — these are what make 'bait it, then commit' actionable.
audit.corrected: Added to dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and spikes[1].text.
